english.title: Person in charge of aeronautical radio station used for air traffic control fail to provide required recording apparatus
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being in charge of an aeronautical radio station at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) which was used for the provision of an air traffic control service by an air traffic control unit, failed to provide recording apparatus in accordance with article 206(4) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 206(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
